about_the_game:
You begin as an ordinary person living in a quiet village. However, as schizophrenic attacks intensify, your life turns into a true nightmare. The village is no longer a familiar place—it has become a scene of absolute terror. Now, you must use your intelligence and courage to survive and escape this torment.

Key Features

A Terrifying Atmosphere
Dark, deserted village roads, detailed environmental designs, and chilling sound effects will make you experience true fear.

Limited Resource Management
In the village, your only support is a few bullets and a gun. You must manage your resources carefully to survive.

Psychological Terror and Constant Tension
Due to the schizophrenic attacks, you begin to see questions on the village signs. Will they guide you on the right path, or lead you to even greater danger?

Survival Against Monsters
Face terrifying creatures without knowing if they are real or merely products of your disturbed mind.

A Deep Story and a Realistic Protagonist
Experience a narrative where the line between reality and madness becomes increasingly blurred, as seen through the eyes of a character fighting a mental illness.

Demo Details

🔹 20 different locations to explore – Each game features random objects, clues, and threats across various areas.
🔹 2 types of weapons – A pistol and a more powerful secondary weapon, both with limited ammunition that must be used cautiously.
🔹 8 types of enemies – Some pose a physical threat, while others attempt to manipulate your mind.
🔹 10 different questions and paths – The route you choose could save you or lead you to an even worse fate.
🔹 The boundary between reality and illusion – As schizophrenia progresses, it becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish real enemies from mere hallucinations.

DEVIL'S WAY 2 promises an unforgettable horror experience with its intense atmosphere, engaging story, and challenging survival mechanics.
